# [PR #358] feat: add GEMM definitions and reference tests (Llama 3.1 70B)

source: https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer-bench/pull/358
state: closed | updated: 2026-04-20T19:39:37Z
labels: 

## 正文

## Summary

Add four GEMM definitions for Llama 3.1/3.3 70B (hidden=8192, intermediate=28672):

| Definition | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `gemm_n10240_k8192` | fused QKV proj (64q+8k+8v heads × 128 = 10240) |
| `gemm_n8192_k8192` | o_proj |
| `gemm_n57344_k8192` | fused gate_up_proj (2 × 28672) |
| `gemm_n8192_k28672` | down_proj |

Coverage: 8 → 14 / 14 for Llama 3.1/3.3 70B (note: rmsnorm_h8192 and fused_add_rmsnorm_h8192 tracked in #356, #357).
